entries.title: Scatter plots
entries.description: Create scatter plots to explore relationships between indicators and compare countries.

entries.title: Start from a shared analysis
entries.description: Open a gallery example or shared analysis in your own Studio session, ask follow-up questions, and edit its charts and tables with AI.

entries.title: A searchable source catalogue
entries.description: Find sources by name or theme, and filter the catalogue to the data you need. Browse related datasets through Aid & ODA, Debt, Climate, Health, Economy, and Humanitarian finance.

entries.title: Gallery publishing tools
entries.description: Internal tools for the DFO team to curate worked examples, edit their descriptions, and choose which canvases appear in the gallery.

entries.title: Publishing reference analyses
entries.description: Publish selected analyses as citable reference views, with a stable citation and a public page that people can find and reuse.

entries.title: Content editing
entries.description: Let the DFO team edit website text, guidance, and example prompts with a CMS.

entries.title: Homepage examples
entries.description: Show a wider range of DFO analyses on the homepage.

entries.title: Built with DFO
entries.description: Explore tools, analyses, and applications built with DFO data and APIs, with links to try them and reuse shared analyses.

entries.title: Chart branding
entries.description: Add an organisation's logo and choose custom chart colours for reports and presentations.

entries.title: Usage reporting
entries.description: Bring website, Studio, API, and MCP usage into reporting that helps the team identify data gaps and show data partners how their datasets are used.

entries.title: Developer keys and usage controls
entries.description: Let developers create API keys for their applications, with clear request limits and usage records.

entries.title: Maps
entries.description: Explore geographic patterns in development finance through maps.

entries.title: Clearer caveats and uncertainty
entries.description: See qualifications such as provisional values, estimates, and coverage gaps alongside a chart or table.

entries.title: Verification for exported charts
entries.description: Check that a chart was exported from DFO by following its link to a DFO record of the chart and its source data.

entries.title: Reported values and projections together
entries.description: Where a source publishes both, follow a series from reported observations into projections, with the projected period clearly marked in charts, tables, and downloads.
